user.title: Connect to HydroNode
user.description: Enter your HydroNode base URL and a Personal Access Token. Create a token in the HydroNode app or web UI under Account → API Tokens.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to HydroNode
reauth_confirm.description: Your HydroNode Personal Access Token is no longer valid. Enter a new one to reconnect.

reconfigure.title: Change HydroNode address
reconfigure.description: Enter https://hydronode.tech to switch domains. Your saved token is reused and the account is verified.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the HydroNode server.
error.invalid_url: Invalid base URL. Use HTTPS without credentials, query parameters or fragments.

abort.already_configured: This HydroNode account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: The token belongs to a different HydroNode account.

data.fire_value_events: Fire an event bus event on every value update
